pages.title: Pygmy Mammoth
pages.text: The pygmy mammoth ($(o)Mammuthus exilis$()) is an extinct dwarf mammoth that lived on the Channel Islands of California during the Late Pleistocene.$(br2)It descended from Columbian mammoths that reached the islands, likely by swimming, when sea levels were lower.$(br2)With limited food on the islands, the mammoths became much smaller over many generations, standing less than two metres tall at the shoulder.
